newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Stratec, Norian sign marketing agreement.
newsitem.headline: Stratec, Norian sign marketing agreement.

text.p: Swiss medical technology company Stratec said it signed an agreement with Norian Corp, based in Cupertino, Calif., involving marketing of Norian SRS, a skeletal repair system.
The agreement gives Stratec sole marketing rights for Norian products in Switzerland, Spain, Portugal, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Great Britian, Ireland and southern Germany.

According to a study by Bank Julius Baer published in April, Stratec achieved 80 percent of its turnover in 1996 from products tied to treatment of fractured bones. It reported group sales of 224.6 million Swiss francs for 1996.
Stratec is based in Oberdorf, Switzerland. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
